column6: Score 3.9 with no Score Breakdown section — the number could not be reconstructed from its own report, which is how the inflation survived.
Breakdown reconciles and the lift is legal, but there is no Case Against and no falsifier. Arithmetic discipline alone does not make an evaluation honest.
The compliant shape. If this ever starts failing, a rule changed underneath the corpus.
Reports write "3.3/5". A naive last-numeric-wins parser read the denominator 5 as the score. Caught by the validator against a real report, not by review.
may progress if conditions are favourable is a disclaimer, not a prediction. An unfalsifiable falsifier is the failure mode the whole mechanism exists to prevent.
A Case Against that lists paper-credential gaps but never asks whether the evidence was produced at the role's scale. This is the exact #185 failure wearing the new section's clothes.
Header, Machine Summary and Global must agree. Divergence means a correction was applied in one place only.
